4.5.1.4.2 Multiple Trigger Sinks Single Trigger Source
The concept of external event communication supports, that a trigger source activates one or more triggered ExecutableEntitys in one or more trigger sinks.
[SWS_Rte_07216] ⌈The RTE generator shall support triggered ExecutableEntitys triggered by the same Trigger of a trigger source (‘1 : n’ communication where n ≥1).⌋(SRS_Rte_00162, SRS_Rte_00216) The execution order of the triggered ExecutableEntitys in the trigger sinks depends from the RteEventToTaskMapping described in chapter 8.5.1 and the
configured priorities of the operating system.
